Now70s.uk.title: Ultimate Love Songs! 1970-1979
Now70s.uk.description: From 'Ticket To Ride' in 1970 to 'Please Don't Go' in 1979 - these are simply the 50 biggest love & break-up songs of the decade, in order.

Now70s.uk.title: Tony Blackburn's SingerSongwriters
Now70s.uk.description: From Joni Mitchell to Judie Tzuke, Al Green to Elton John - the 70s was a classic decade for singer-songwriters who have stood the test of time. Tony Blackburn chooses the tunes.

Now70s.uk.title: Hopelessly Devoted To You! Top 25
Now70s.uk.description: Another selection of classic love songs from the 70s.

Now70s.uk.title: Daydreamers: A Whole Day of Love!
Now70s.uk.description: Non-stop love songs, back to back all day, from the era of Leo Sayer, Carpenters, The Bee Gees & Minnie Riperton.

Now70s.uk.title: Bruno Brookes UK Top 40 of Xmas
Now70s.uk.description: A definite countdown of the UK's biggest Christmas singles of all time - spanning 7 decades of seasonal songs. Bruno Brookes has the festive facts & figures at hand.

Now70s.uk.title: 1972 Unleashed!
Now70s.uk.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1972.

Now70s.uk.title: Rod Stewart: 1971-1979

Now70s.uk.title: American No.1s of 1972
Now70s.uk.description: In order - 12 videos that hit the top of the US chart in 1972. Some are obvious, but there are a few surprises along the way.

Now70s.uk.title: Kid Jensen's 25 Great Guitar Riffs
Now70s.uk.description: Rock, pop, punk and new wave...across them all, a great chunky guitar riff made these 25 handpicked gems hard to beat. Let Kid Jensen guide you through the lot and crank it to 11.

Now70s.uk.title: Far Out, Man!
Now70s.uk.description: Over-bearded men & leftfield ladies - all with fabulous tunes! These are alternative hits from the west coast, the underground & the counter culture of the 1970s.

Now70s.uk.title: Morning Has Broken!
Now70s.uk.description: From the era of glam rock, new wave and disco, it's all the hits from just one decade - the 1970s! Platform boots and flares at the ready.

Now70s.uk.title: Essential 70s: The No 3s

Now70s.uk.title: Ballroom Blitz! 1967-1976

Now70s.uk.title: Retro Rewind! 70s Edition
Now70s.uk.description: From hippies to punk rockers, via folk, funk, soul & disco - these are the classic songs that made the 70s.

Now70s.uk.description: Hit songs with few words - the 70s was full of them! From Elton John & Mike Oldfield to long-forgotten acts like Hot Butter & Focus. And yes - there are some bagpipes.

Now70s.uk.title: Bruno Brookes-Never Even A Top 10?

Now70s.uk.title: Blondie: Picture These Vids!
